title: Technology Sector Update for 01/03/2019: SWKS,RESN,IZEA,AAPL - Nasdaq.com

Technology stocks extended their steep declines this afternoon. At last look, the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 were losing nearly 4.2% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was falling over 5.2%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(-) Skyworks Solutions ( SWKS ) tumbled over 11% lower shortly before Thursday's closing bell after analysts at KeyBanc dropped their investment recommendation for the specialty chipmaker to sector weight From overweight.
In other sector news:
(+) IZEA Worldwide ( IZEA ) jumped over 29% higher at one point on Thursday after the ecommerce platform connecting marketers and content creators said it won multiple contracts during December.
(-) Resonant ( RESN ) was down almost 4% Thursday late afternoon, giving back an early 4% advance that followed the maker of radio frequency front-end filters for the mobile device industry reporting four new license agreements with its top Tier 1 customer.
(-) Apple ( AAPL ) dropped 10% to a 20-month low of $142.00 a share on Thursday after the device giant late Wednesday slashed its fiscal Q1 revenue forecast, blaming fewer iPhone upgrades than anticipated in China and other markets. It now expects around $84 billion in sales for the three months ended Dec. 30, lagging the $91.4 billion Capital IQ consensus.
